content: Modern SaaS dashboard (Stripe/Linear/Vercel-style) design token systems commonly define: spacing on a 4px or 8px base-unit scale (e.g. 4/8/12/16/24/32/48), a type scale with a modest ratio (not dramatic swings), 2-3 border-radius steps (sm ~4px, md ~8px, lg ~12-16px), and a 3-level shadow/elevation system (shadow-sm/md/lg) used sparingly. Contemporary trend: borders/shadows/decoration shrinking, hierarchy from type weight and spacing rather than heavy chrome, color reserved for state/semantic meaning with one primary accent and neutral surfaces elsewhere.
